screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_space.sub: Click a world to see it. Coal or blaze powder used on the pod fuels it.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_space.dead: Dark. Every world it knows is dust. Go back in time.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_space.boss: Mission: the occupier's boss is coming
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_space.title: Titles: %1$s
space.jaymospowers.rustfall.free_intro: Rustfall's iron-masters bled the world dry and set captains over the ruins. Their boss sits above them all. Break the grip.
space.jaymospowers.rustfall.conquer_intr: Rustfall's natives are proud and heavy, and their champions will not bend. Beat them and plant your flag where all can see.
space.jaymospowers.rustfall.free_done: The captains are broken and their boss is down. Rustfall breathes again.
space.jaymospowers.rustfall.conquer_done: The champions kneel and your flag stands over Rustfall. It is yours.
space.jaymospowers.glacia.free_intro: A warlord froze Glacia's seas to hold its people. His captains patrol the ice. Cut them down, then him.
space.jaymospowers.glacia.conquer_intro: Glacia's ice-clans guard their frozen sea with champions. Meet them in turn, then raise your flag over the ice.
space.jaymospowers.glacia.free_done: The warlord falls and the ice begins to crack. Glacia is free.
space.jaymospowers.glacia.conquer_done: The ice-clans yield. Your flag cracks in the wind over Glacia.
space.jaymospowers.cinder.free_done: The forge-lord is dead and the furnaces are the people's again. Cinder is free.
space.jaymospowers.cinder.conquer_done: The forge-champions are beaten. Your flag burns bright over Cinder.
space.jaymospowers.cinder.free_intro: A forge-lord works Cinder's people at the furnaces under his captains' whips. End it.
space.jaymospowers.cinder.conquer_intro: Cinder's forge-clans live on the edge of the lava and fear nothing. Beat their champions and take the forges.
message.jaymospowers.space_no_pod: Open the star map at a pod and stay close to it.
message.jaymospowers.space_cooldown: The pod is cooling. Ready in %1$s s.
message.jaymospowers.space_future_dead: The star map is dark. A lifetime on, every world it knows is dust. Only going back in time leads home.
message.jaymospowers.space_unreachable: The star map shows nothing there. The world is not on this server.
message.jaymospowers.space_landed: You touch down on %1$s. A pod waits to take you back.
message.jaymospowers.space_no_mission: There is no mission on this world.
message.jaymospowers.space_under_way: The mission is already under way.
message.jaymospowers.space_begin_free: Free the world: defeat %1$s of the occupier's captains, then their boss. Fighters near you share the work.
message.jaymospowers.space_begin_conquer: Conquer the world: defeat %1$s of the natives' champions, then plant the Conquest Flag. Fighters near you share the work.
message.jaymospowers.space_mission_here: %1$s asks something of a fighter. Open the star map at a pod to begin the mission.
message.jaymospowers.space_captains_down: The captains are down. Their boss comes.
message.jaymospowers.space_champions_dow: The champions are down. Plant your flag.
message.jaymospowers.space_flag: A Conquest Flag. Right-click the ground to plant it.
message.jaymospowers.space_flag_not_yet: The flag is not for planting yet, or not here.
message.jaymospowers.space_flag_blocked: Clear room for the pole and the cloth first.
message.jaymospowers.pod_wreck.missing: The wreck comes apart in your hands. Still missing: %s.
message.jaymospowers.pod_wreck.whole: Nothing is missing, but a fin is bent.
message.jaymospowers.pod.missing: The pod can't lift. It lacks its %s.
message.jaymospowers.pod.no_tank: There is no tank to put it in.
message.jaymospowers.pod.hard_landing: She comes down hard, and something shakes loose.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.page1: Run thirty-one. Holds full by the second dark. Teo swears the tall ones followed us up from the shaft again. They never come past the lamps. They only watch.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.page2: Old Hask put his ear to the dust and said it hums like the great stones back home do in a storm. Then he laughed at us for listening. Nobody laughed on the way back to the pod.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.page3: Something hit the burner on the climb. We're going down hard. If anyone finds her: the tank, the canopy, the mast and the plates are gone, and a fin is bent. The ones we lost may lie where the old ships fell. She still wants to fly.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_space.burns: The trip burns %1$s fuel; the pod holds %2$s.
message.jaymospowers.space_no_fuel: The pod needs %1$s fuel and holds %2$s. Use coal or blaze powder on it.
space.jaymospowers.home.about: Where you flew from. The pod comes down on that spot, or at the world's spawn if that world is gone.
space.jaymospowers.moon.about: Grey dust under a black sky. You weigh a third of what you do at home and can fall a long way unhurt. Ore lies under the dust, and Endermen walk the dark.
space.jaymospowers.rustfall.about: A red, rusted world. Its weight slows you and keeps your jumps low, but Z Fighters train twice as fast under it. It has a mission: free it or conquer it.
space.jaymospowers.glacia.about: Frozen sea and ice to the edge of sight, and cold enough to hurt. It has a mission: free it or conquer it.
space.jaymospowers.cinder.about: The world nearest the sun, all lava and ore. The pod sets down on a cave floor, and the heat makes you hungry fast. It has a mission: free it or conquer it.
space.jaymospowers.maw.about: A black hole in empty space. It pulls you in slowly and never stops, and its rim throws you back hurt. Wrecks with rare loot drift round it, and the pod sets down on one.
space.jaymospowers.verdant.about: A green world of plains, moss and vines, with open land to come down on.
